subject: LLM query derivatives: custody, audit logs, and requested TTLs
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kaur <p.kaur@novushealth.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@novushealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: LLM query derivatives: custody, audit logs, and requested TTLs

Hi Priya / Samir —

Great to meet today — thanks for the time. Quick post-demo recap focused on the data/PII questions you raised and the concrete asks you had on retention and logging. Below is a short summary of what we persist by default, the configurable knobs, and the actions we need from your side to finalize the mutual action plan.

What Redwood persists (defaults)
- Request payload (prompt + metadata): persisted only if you enable "persist_prompts" for a route. Default: OFF for new trial accounts.
- Model outputs (generated text): can be persisted as "derivatives" (for analytics, search or audit) — default retention: 365 days when enabled.
- Session telemetry (latency, error traces): retained 30 days by default for hosted accounts; retained longer under Dedicated/Private with configurable retention.
- Audit logs (who called what, IP, route): retained 13 months, immutable, accessible to customers via the Console API.
- KV/prefix caches and in-memory token caches: ephemeral, not written to durable storage (TTL ~2 minutes).

Configurable controls
- Per-route storage toggle (on/off) and per-field redaction rules (PII scrub).
- TTL override: can set 0 days (ephemeral only), 30 days, 90 days, 365 days for persisted derivatives; custom retention via contract for Enterprise.
- Region pinning for persisted artifacts: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1 (we can enable additional regions on request).
- Encryption: data at rest encrypted with customer or Redwood KMS; in transit TLS 1.3.

Immediate asks from Novus (please):
1) A mapping that shows which classes of prompt data you consider PII (examples: PHI, name, DOB, MRN) vs non-PII. If you can attach a sample anonymized payload, we can create recommended redaction rules.
2) Desired retention TTLs for persisted outputs and embeddings (if you plan to enable them): options (0 / 30 / 90 / 365).
3) Any regional constraints (must stay in us-east / must stay in EU) or regulatory controls we should apply.

Attachments: redwood_data_terms_summary.pdf — short doc that covers defaults and toggles (see page 2 for per-route settings).

Proposed next steps
- If we get the mapping + desired TTLs by EOD Fri (2027-06-18), we’ll produce a one-page custody matrix and a sample log excerpt showing what an audit record looks like.
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min technical call with Marissa (solutions) and Jonas (privacy lead) to walk the matrix and redaction samples.

Thanks — I looped Marissa and Jonas on follow-up to get technical confirmation and attachments.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifying Qs before we pass a mapping to our security team: 

1) Our primary concern is free-text user prompts — will Redwood ever persist raw user prompts by default? We want the option for prompts to be strictly ephemeral unless explicitly enabled.
2) We need the ability to disable storage at a route level (yes/no?) and to have per-field redaction (e.g., always strip MRNs).
3) Where are persisted artifacts stored by default (region + cloud account)? Can you confirm US-only for our initial deployment?
4) We will need SOC 2 Type II and a recent pen-test summary before procurement can sign off — can you provide a redacted SOC2?
5) Finally, could you include a small sample of what an audit log entry looks like (fields, timestamps, IP) so we can confirm it meets our logging policy?

If you can reply with the above (and the earlier doc), I’ll circulate to security. We can target EOD Friday (2027-06-18).

Best,
Priya Kaur

Hi Priya / Samir —

Thanks for the follow-up. Jonas and I reviewed the ask and below are concrete confirmations and recommended defaults. We kept answers short so your reviewers can quickly digest.

1) Raw prompts
- Default behavior: prompts are NOT persisted unless a customer enables "persist_prompts" for a route. For Hosted accounts we default this to OFF for trials.
- Ephemeral-only option: yes — set TTL=0 and we will not write prompt text to durable storage; prompts will be only in-memory and evicted (~2 minutes).

2) Per-route disable & per-field redaction
- Per-route disable: yes (route config flag: persist_prompts: true|false).
- Per-field redaction: yes — can supply regex-based rules or a small set of common field rules (mrn, ssn, dob) that run before persistence.

3) Region & storage account
- Default storage region for your account: us-east-1 (AWS).
- Persisted derivatives live in a Redwood-managed S3 bucket in us-east-1 by default; Enterprise customers can request dedicated storage or cross-account arrangement.
- All persisted artifacts are encrypted at rest using AWS KMS; we support customer-managed keys for Enterprise.

4) SOC 2 & pen-test evidence
- Attached: SOC2-report-redacted.pdf (redacted). We also maintain a shorter security whitepaper and a pen-test summary — we can provide the latter under an NDA.

5) Audit log sample (fields)
- Sample (redacted): {timestamp: 2027-06-14T22:18:43Z, account_id: 4521, route: /api/v1/generate, event: GENERATE_CALL, latency_ms: 123, model: redwood-4b-v1, ip: 3.89.120.45, user_agent: "NovusApp/1.2", request_id: rq_9f8e...} — note: IPs are logged for security and access reviews, audit logs are immutable and retained 13 months.

Retention recommendations (what we propose for Novus)
- Prompts: TTL=0 (ephemeral) for user-entered free text.
- Generated outputs (derivatives): TTL=365 days if you intend to use embeddings/search; else TTL=30 days.
- Session telemetry: 30 days.
- Audit logs: 13 months (immutable).

Attachments included: redwood-storage-matrix_v1.xlsx (filled with defaults), sample_log_excerpt.txt (redacted), SOC2-report-redacted.pdf.

If those defaults work, please confirm and we’ll add these to the HubSpot record and the MLP. If you need a formal addendum limiting storage to only in-memory (no persisted derivatives at all), we can produce contract language for procurement.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if you want to walk the matrix together.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
